title: Stubby has a new engine!
content: Stubby recently blew a diesel trying to crawl some near the Blackburn summits. After some subtle changes to the drivetrain and a new crawler case, we replaced the engine with a brand new Gavril 6.9. It definitely performs better than the old engine. (NOTE; Contact me at Discord for an engine replacement!

title: S15 has a new body!
preview: Swapping the body for a cut one was a great decision.
content: Not much had been changed, we cut the fenders some and made sure the wheels didn't dig into the upper body. This one was taken into the shop by Demetrius, bought for 20k. Was promised to be shipped back to Asia somewhere but failed to pay fees for import. We got a hold of it and now it's ours.

title: New company being established.
preview: Servicing was hard but we got it done.
content: After getting a hold of luke and presenting the idea, he said it sounded good. We updated our facility to manage the new fenders and also bought a new tire rack. Yay.
